<style>
  :root{ --sky:#EAF4FB; --sky-deep:#CDE7F7; --ink:#1D3557; --coral:#FF6F61; --coral-dark:#E4573F;
    --sun:#FFC93C; --grass:#06D6A0; --grass-dark:#04A97F; --rose-dark:#C7315A; --card:#FFFFFF; --wood:#C48A5A; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){ --sky:#101826; --sky-deep:#0B1220; --ink:#EAF2FB; --card:#16202E; --wood:#7C5A3B; } }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{ --sky:#101826; --sky-deep:#0B1220; --ink:#EAF2FB; --card:#16202E; --wood:#7C5A3B; }
  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body{ height:100%; }
  html{ scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); }
  body{ margin:0; font-family:'Andika',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink);
    background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 15% -10%, var(--sky-deep), transparent 60%),

    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:100%; padding-left:16px; padding-right:16px; }
  .stage{ width:100%; max-width:480px; margin:32px 0; }
  .title{ font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(1.5rem,6vw,2rem); text-align:center; margin:0 0 4px; }
  .title .accent{ color:var(--coral-dark); }
  .subtitle{ text-align:center; font-size:.92rem; margin:0 0 20px; opacity:.85; line-height:1.4; }
  .rail{ height:10px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--wood),transparent); border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; max-width:300px; margin:0 auto -6px; opacity:.9; }
  .card{ background:var(--card); border-radius:22px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(29,53,87,.35); position:relative; }
  .hanger{ position:absolute; top:-26px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); font-size:1.8rem; filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.15)); }

  .level-buttons{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; }

    background:var(--sky-deep); color:var(--ink); text-align:left; transition:transform .08s ease, background-color .15s ease; }
  .level-btn small{ display:block; font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:.8rem; opacity:.75; margin-top:4px; }
  .level-btn:hover{ background:var(--coral); color:#fff; }
  .level-btn:active{ transform:scale(.98); }

  .visual-row{ display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:8px 0 14px; }
  .clock-face{ width:92px; height:92px; color:var(--ink); }
  .icon-emoji{ font-size:2.3rem; line-height:1; }

  .prompt-label{ text-align:center; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--coral-dark); margin:6px 0 8px; }
  .tag{ background:var(--sun); color:#3A2A00; border-radius:14px; padding:16px; text-align:center; position:relative; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .tag::before{ content:""; position:absolute; top:-9px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:16px; height:16px; background:var(--sun); border-radius:50%; box-shadow:inset 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15); }
  .prompt{ font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(1.1rem,5vw,1.4rem); margin:0; }

  .feedback{ min-height:34px; text-align:center; font-weight:700; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 10px; margin-bottom:14px; font-size:.96rem; line-height:1.35; }
  .feedback.correct{ background:rgba(6,214,160,.15); color:var(--grass-dark); }
  .feedback.wrong{ background:rgba(239,71,111,.12); color:var(--rose-dark); }
  .feedback .solution{ display:block; font-weight:700; margin-top:2px; }

  form{ display:flex; gap:10px; }
  input[type="text"]{ flex:1; font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-size:1.03rem; font-weight:700; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:12px; border:2px solid var(--sky-deep); background:transparent; color:var(--ink); outline-offset:2px; }
  input[type="text"]:focus-visible{ outline:3px solid var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral); }
  input[type="text"]::placeholder{ color:var(--ink); opacity:.4; }

  button{ font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; border:none; border-radius:12px; padding:12px 18px; cursor:pointer; background:var(--coral); color:#fff; transition:transform .08s ease, background-color .15s ease; }
  button:hover{ background:var(--coral-dark); }
  button:active{ transform:scale(.96); }
  button:focus-visible{ outline:3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:2px; }
  button.go{ background:var(--grass); }
  button.go:hover{ background:var(--grass-dark); }

  .scorebar{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:18px; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; opacity:.85; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
  .scorebar .num{ color:var(--coral-dark); }
  .switch-level{ background:none; border:none; color:var(--ink); opacity:.6; font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.82rem; cursor:pointer; padding:4px; text-decoration:underline; }
  .switch-level:hover{ opacity:1; }

  /* Flashcard (1 Stern) */
  .flip-scene{ perspective: 1000px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .flip-card{ position:relative; width:100%; min-height:180px; cursor:pointer; }

  .flip-face{ position:absolute; inset:0; backface-visibility:hidden; border-radius:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:16px; text-align:center; }
  .flip-front{ background:var(--sun); color:#3A2A00; }
  .flip-back{ background:var(--grass); color:#04321F; transform:rotateY(180deg); }
  .flip-text{ font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.3rem; }
  .flip-hint{ font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; opacity:.65; text-align:center; margin:0 0 4px; }

  /* Uhr einstellen (2 Sterne) */
  .clock-set{ width:220px; height:220px; margin:4px auto 18px; touch-action:none; }
  .clock-set-face{ position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%; background:var(--card); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--sky-deep); }
  .clock-num{ position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink); pointer-events:none; }
  .clock-tick{ position:absolute; width:3px; height:10px; background:var(--ink); border-radius:2px; pointer-events:none; opacity:.55; }
  .hand-handle{ position:absolute; width:28px; height:28px; margin:-14px; border-radius:50%; cursor:grab; touch-action:none; }
  .hand-handle.hour-handle{ background:rgba(228,87,63,.18); border:2px solid var(--coral-dark); }
  .hand-handle.minute-handle{ background:rgba(29,53,87,.12); border:2px solid var(--ink); }
  .hand{ position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:50%; transform-origin:50% 100%; border-radius:4px; pointer-events:none; }
  .hour-hand{ width:6px; height:26%; margin-left:-3px; background:var(--coral-dark); }
  .minute-hand{ width:4px; height:40%; margin-left:-2px; background:var(--ink); }
  .hand-center{ position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:12px; height:12px; margin:-6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink); pointer-events:none; }

  /* Multiple Choice (jetzt 3 Sterne) */
  .mc-options{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
  .mc-btn{ background:var(--sky-deep); color:var(--ink); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; font-family:'Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; text-align:left; }
  .mc-btn:hover{ background:var(--coral); color:#fff; }
  .mc-btn.mc-correct{ background:var(--grass); color:#04321F; }
  .mc-btn.mc-wrong{ background:var(--rose-dark); color:#fff; }
  .mc-btn:disabled{ cursor:default; opacity:1; }

  .hidden{ display:none !important; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *{ transition:none !important; } }
  .visually-hidden{ position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; }

  /* ===== Theme: Himmelblau + Andika ===== */
  :root{
    --sky:#E8F2FC; --sky-deep:#D4E7F9; --ink:#34567A;
    --coral:#9DC8F0; --coral-dark:#4A86BD; --sun:#D4E7F9;
    --grass:#BFEBD6; --grass-dark:#2F8A66; --rose-dark:#B84A62;
    --card:#FFFFFF; --wood:#BCD3EA; --btnink:#1B3552;
  }
  body{ background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 15% -10%, #D4E7F9, transparent 60%),
                    radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 110% 10%, #FFE9DC, transparent 55%), #E8F2FC; }
  button{ color:var(--btnink); }
  button:hover{ background:#86B9E6; }
  button.go:hover{ background:#A8E3C9; }
  .level-btn:hover, .mc-btn:hover{ background:#9DC8F0; color:#1B3552; }
  .tag, .flip-front{ color:#1B3552; }
  .flip-back{ color:#1B4D38; }
  .mc-btn.mc-correct{ color:#1B4D38; }
  .scorebar .num{ color:var(--coral-dark); }
  /* Andika gibt es nur in normaler Strichstärke -> keine künstliche Fettschrift */
  *{ font-weight:400 !important; font-synthesis:none; }
  .title{ font-size:clamp(1.7rem,6.5vw,2.2rem); }
  .prompt{ letter-spacing:.2px; }
  /* Titel in Fredoka */

  /* ===== iPad / Touch: alles auf einen Bildschirm, kein Scrollen ===== */

  .card{ padding:calc(var(--u,8px)*2.4) clamp(14px, calc(var(--u,8px)*3), 24px) !important; }

  /* ===== Theorie-Block ===== */
  .theory-btn{ position:fixed; top:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); right:max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); z-index:20;
    background:#fff; color:var(--ink); border:2px solid var(--coral); border-radius:999px; padding:6px 16px !important; min-height:44px;

  .theory-btn:hover{ background:var(--sky-deep); }

    padding:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 12px max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }

    box-shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(20,40,70,.6); overflow:hidden; }
  .theory-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 14px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--sky-deep); flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .theory-head h2{ font-family:'Fredoka','Andika',sans-serif; font-weight:600 !important; font-size:1.3rem; margin:0; color:var(--coral-dark); margin-right:auto; }

  .t-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap:16px; align-items:start; }
